# Clever Daycare

> Quality play-based childcare services across multiple Calgary locations offering infant through kindergarten programs with flexible scheduling, nutrition partnerships, and emergent curriculum.

Clever Daycare operates licensed childcare facilities throughout Calgary, Alberta, featuring age-specific programs (infant, toddler, preschool, kindergarten), flexible service options including drop-in care, and partnerships with providers like Top Meal for nutrition services. The organization emphasizes safety, early childhood education, and family-centered care.

## Key Topics

- Play-based learning

## Age-Specific Programs

- [Infant Daycare in Calgary – Trusted Newborn Childcare](https://cleverdaycare.ca/infant): Infant and newborn daycare program in Calgary with personalized care
- [Toddler Daycare in Calgary – Programs for 1–3 Year Olds](https://cleverdaycare.ca/toddler): Toddler daycare program for ages 1-3 with play-based curriculum
- [Preschool Daycare in Calgary – Early Learning Program](https://cleverdaycare.ca/preschool): Preschool program for ages 3-4 focused on school readiness
- [Kindergarten Daycare in Calgary – Trusted Childcare](https://cleverdaycare.ca/kindergarten): Kindergarten-age childcare with structure, confidence-building, and STEM

## Locations & Facilities

- [Daycare in Glamorgan Calgary – Childcare Services](https://cleverdaycare.ca/glamorgan): Clever Daycare Glamorgan location with infant through kindergarten care
- [Daycare in University District – Licensed Childcare](https://cleverdaycare.ca/university-district): University District location offering night care and full-age programs
- [Daycare in Aspen Glen Calgary – Childcare Services](https://cleverdaycare.ca/aspen): Aspen Glen location providing childcare for infants through kindergarten
